item.text:
This pass added two scope checks rather than a new defect.

The excluded `examples/raft-kv-memstore` suite cannot be built in the offline environment because `actix-web` is absent from the local registry:

```
error: no matching package named `actix-web` found
location searched: crates.io index
required by package `raft-kv-memstore ...`
```

That is recorded as a build-prerequisite block in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/report.md), with the captured error in [example-memstore-blocked-stderr.txt](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/audit/logs/example-memstore-blocked-stderr.txt).

`cargo build -p openraft --release` passed, confirming the release profile compiles with debug assertions disabled.

The confirmed findings remain:

- High: snapshot-install purge ordering can leave an unrecoverable state after a crash.
- Medium: documented-valid `PartialSuccess(None)` panics the leader in debug builds.
- Medium: `snapshot_max_chunk_size = 0` loops on zero-byte snapshot chunks.
- Low/Medium: `purge_batch_size = 0` underflows in `calc_purge_upto()`.
- Low/Medium: blocking `add_learner()` returns `Ok` after a leadership change while the learner is not caught up.
- Low/Medium: `heartbeat_interval = 0` creates an unthrottled tick loop.
- Low/Medium: `install_snapshot_timeout = 0` makes every snapshot RPC time out immediately.

The source-based `QuitLeader` replication-map retention remains the only unresolved follow-up. Sources, logs, and patches are under [audit](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/audit).
